description: The National Pollutant Release Inventory is Canada's public inventory of pollutant releases to air, water and land, disposals and transfers for recycling, reported each year by facilities and published by Environment and Climate Change Canada. The bulk data files cover all years from 1993 to the latest reporting year (the catalogue record gives coverage to 2024, metadata modified 1 May 2026) in five CSV files in normalised list format suited to pivot tables: releases, on-site and off-site disposals including tailings and waste rock, transfers for recycling or treatment, facility comments, and geographic locations of every reporting facility. Files are free downloads from the ECCC Data Mart, linked from the Open Government Portal, under the Open Government Licence - Canada, and the portal also offers single-year tables by facility and ten-year tables by province, industry and substance. Caveats: only facilities above reporting thresholds report, quantities are facility estimates, and ECCC publishes a guide on using and interpreting the data. For simulation it gives the pollutant and tailings inventories of Canadian industrial and mining facilities, with coordinates, for hazard exposure, natech and environmental impact scenarios. Related catalogue records include the U.S. Toxics Release Inventory, the Australian National Pollutant Inventory and the European Industrial Emissions Portal.
